prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: sideswipe while changing lanes in League City, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported neck strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1131; do not mention it.)
text: Officer narrative. On arrival at the location in League City, Texas, I observed two vehicles stopped in the right and center lanes of the roadway with visible contact damage to the left rear quarter panel of Driver 2's vehicle and the right front fender of Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 1 stated that they were traveling in the center lane and signaled a lane change into the right lane when Driver 2's vehicle moved into the same space, causing a sideswipe. Driver 2 stated that they checked their mirror, did not see Driver 1's vehicle, and believed the lane was clear before the contact occurred. A Passenger riding in Driver 1's vehicle was present at the scene and was evaluated by EMS. Driver 1 reported neck strain and pain with rotation of the head and was transported to a local medical facility for further evaluation. No citations were issued at the scene pending review of statements. Weather was clear and the roadway was dry. Both vehicles were driven from the scene after exchanging information.
